name: Robtex free API (passive DNS forward/reverse) and web lookup pages
tier_rationale: Small company with an identifiable operator, public documentation and a long public track record (A8 community); 'Robtex free API = noncommercial (non-commercial, low volume), tier community' (P015 cond 1).

reliability.justification: Large passive DNS collection, but forward answers carry the same recent time_last on every record (observed 2026-11-25/26, including a 2009 address of example.com): time_last is a refresh time, not a last observation, so Robtex-only records never count as current.

pdns.title: Robtex freeapi /pdns/forward/{domain} and /pdns/reverse/{ip} (NDJSON: rrname, rrdata, rrtype, time_first, time_last, count)

terms.quote: Robtex free API = noncommercial ('non-commercial, low volume'), tier community

pdns.notes: Quote: binding council text (P015 cond 1; A1 initial class 'Robtex = noncommercial'). Off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (a licence_allow entry or a Robtex Pro plan); while skipped the web pages robtex.com/dns-lookup/{domain} and /ip-lookup/{ip} are the manual links (pack passive_dns_robtex, P015 cond 3). NDJSON parsed line by line, malformed or truncated lines skipped; min_interval >= 2 s and the published 10 requests/hour per egress IP as the P334 budget (8/hour, P015 cond 4). An empty answer is the body '[]'. Reverse lookups of popular IPs are slow (9.9.9.9 sent nothing in 20 s): timeout 20 s, could not verify.
pdns.licensed_alternative: Robtex Pro API (proapi.robtex.com) under a company plan recorded in licence_allow.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-2 (P015, module passive_dns). www.robtex.com serves the manual lookup pages only (never automated).
